image_description: A top-down flat-lay photograph of various hand tools, maintenance supplies, and hardware arranged neatly on a round wooden table. Visible items include screwdrivers, pliers (locking and needle-nose), a ratchet wrench, Allen keys, tubes of sealant/adhesive, cans of WD-40 and carburetor cleaner, sanding sponges, loose nuts/washers, and a small hammer at the bottom. The background is a wood-grain surface with a visible floor edge in the bottom right corner.
